description: This file defines the 'Mortgage' class, which models a mortgage loan, including calculations for monthly payments, amortization schedules, and related financial metrics.

classes.name: Mortgage
classes.description: Represents a mortgage loan with methods to generate amortization schedules and compute financial metrics.

classes.name: Mortgage.PaymentRecord
classes.description: Encapsulates details of individual mortgage payments, including principal, interest, and remaining balance.

methods.name: Mortgage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes mortgage parameters and calculates derived values such as monthly payment and total interest.

methods.name: generateAmortizationSchedule
methods.description: Generates an array of PaymentRecord objects representing each payment in the amortization schedule.

methods.name: generateYearlyAmortizationSchedule
methods.description: Generates an array of PaymentRecord objects summarizing payments per year.

methods.name: getPrincipal
methods.description: Returns the principal amount of the mortgage.

methods.name: getLoanTermInYears
methods.description: Returns the loan term in years.

methods.name: getNumberOfPayments
methods.description: Returns the total number of payments.

methods.name: getTotalPayment
methods.description: Returns the total payment over the loan term.

methods.name: getTotalInterest
methods.description: Returns the total interest paid over the loan term.
